notes.backend: Choose windows or web, or specify backend_path for a custom adapter. See plugin.json.
notes.locator: Set title_pattern or process_name for Windows. Ambiguous or missing targets are refused.
notes.single_instance_rule: Use one target instance. Close stale instances and record the target process ID.
notes.input_method: postmessage sends window messages and may be ignored by Raw Input apps. sendinput requires the target to be foreground.
notes.screenshot_method: auto prefers PrintWindow and falls back to screen copy for blank captures. Existing screenshots are preserved.
notes.debug_keys: Developer diagnostics only. Keep debug input out of acceptance cases and evidence.
notes.schema: v3. Legacy hint_region, shot_dir, and keys.allow_postmessage are supported.
